disclosure: Fixed stock synthetic voices, exact delivered clips with one-second gaps. Technical audition, not perceptual acceptance.

intervals.speaker: Sister Lumen
intervals.direction: Firm capacity limit, practical rather than scolding.
intervals.text: Carrying six papers isn't six places in the room. The last two would arrive to a full window.

intervals.speaker: Sister Lumen
intervals.direction: Clear privacy refusal; measured emphasis on the desk.
intervals.text: No. Give them my desk, not somebody else's front door.

intervals.speaker: Sister Lumen
intervals.direction: Honest limit followed by three workable alternatives.
intervals.text: I won't promise the third. Carry it to the later desk yourself, fund another carrier, or change the split.

intervals.speaker: Sister Lumen
intervals.direction: Remember actual funded work without promising clinic attendance.
intervals.text: That split needed the extra carrier you funded. Keep the work beside the plan.

intervals.speaker: Sister Lumen
intervals.direction: Acknowledge the runner’s actual additional trip.
intervals.text: That split needed your extra later trip. Keep the work beside the plan.

intervals.speaker: Sister Lumen
intervals.direction: Remember the accepted return contact, without erasing a refusal.
intervals.text: That split needed your clinic return bundle. Keep the work beside the plan.

intervals.speaker: Quill
intervals.direction: Dry equipment advice with ordinary concern for the recipient.
intervals.text: Keep enough for the person on the other end of the job.

intervals.speaker: Sister Lumen
intervals.direction: Quiet reassurance about an ordinary rest seat.
intervals.text: This one doesn't keep your hour.

intervals.speaker: Sister Lumen
intervals.direction: Give the silence room before returning to unfinished work.
intervals.text: Now decide who needs what you have left,

intervals.speaker: Sera
intervals.direction: Warm practical invitation after any shelter outcome.
intervals.text: Come back when it’s daylight. A place to sleep is the start of a night, not the whole of it.

intervals.speaker: Edda
intervals.direction: Measured earned handover; the previous invoices remain disputed.
intervals.text: One clean number. One receiver. The old charges are still a fight.

intervals.speaker: Edda
intervals.direction: Steady recovery, no denial of the logged badge query.
intervals.text: We can close the key. We can’t make that query disappear.

intervals.speaker: Edda
intervals.direction: Practical alternative to activating the badge reader.
intervals.text: The staffed desk is slower. You don’t need to wake that thing to ask.

intervals.speaker: Mara
intervals.direction: Present-day uncertainty, distinct from her recorded testimony.
intervals.text: Now I wait for an answer I can't write for them.
